description: Find every website that runs the same ad or analytics pixel. Lists the websites we checked whose homepage or Google Tag Manager containers load the pixel, so websites with one owner, dealer group or agency show up together. Takes a pixel id as websites_find_pixels returns it. 50 per page, sorted by domain, with the total. Charges 0.1 credits per returned website; a pixel on no checked website is free.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1; 50 websites per page

name: websites_find_by_pixel

found.description: true when at least one checked website runs the pixel

totalCount.description: Every checked website that runs the pixel, across all pages

checkedAt.description: When the website was last checked

title: Find every website that runs the same ad or analytics pixel
